full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white photographic close-up of a woman's face, tightly cropped across the forehead and outer cheeks while the lips remain visible. Her pale grey face fills most of the image, with the right eye fully visible near the upper-right corner and the eye at the far left partly hidden behind sweeping hair. Dark hair falls across the top and right side, forming a nearly black frame around the exposed skin. The nose sits just left of centre, its bridge catching a soft highlight and its nostril fading into shadow. The lips lie near the lower-left quadrant, softly parted along a narrow dark line. Fine freckles and small pores create a granular texture across the cheek and nose. A few loose strands cross the forehead and curve beside the cheek, while broader masses of hair merge into the black background. The clearer eye looks forward with a small catchlight; its lashes and iris are sharply defined compared with the softer skin transitions. The expression remains neutral and direct. The crop excludes the shoulders and clothing, keeping the image focused entirely on the facial surface and hair. The face turns only slightly, enough for the nose bridge to sit off centre and the far cheek to fall into darker tone. The forehead disappears beneath a sweep of hair, while the lower edge cuts close beneath the mouth. This compressed framing leaves almost no empty background and makes the visible skin texture an important part of the image. The hair is rendered in broad black masses with a few fine strands tracing its boundary. A soft pale highlight runs from the brow down the bridge of the nose and across part of the cheek, while the mouth remains clearly separated by a thin dark line. The photographic tonal transitions preserve fine skin detail and individual strands. The brightest tones stay on the central face, while the outer edges quickly approach black. Soft frontal light brightens the exposed nose ridge, cheek and brow, while the hair-covered side falls into deep charcoal shadow. The tonal range moves from near-white highlights through silver-grey midtones to black, with no colour accents. The overall composition is intimate and asymmetrical: one eye anchors the upper-right area, the partly hair-covered second eye pulls toward the left edge, and the dark hair encloses the softly textured face in a high-contrast field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白摄影面部特写，额头和两侧脸颊被紧密裁切，双唇仍在画面内可见。浅灰色面部占据大部分画面，右眼在右上附近完整可见，最左侧的眼睛则被斜过的发束局部遮住。深色头发垂落在顶部和右侧，围出近乎黑色的发际框线。鼻子位于中央偏左，鼻梁接住柔和亮光，鼻孔则融入阴影。双唇靠近左下区域，沿一道细暗线轻轻分开。细小雀斑与毛孔在脸颊和鼻子上形成颗粒质感。几缕散发横过额头，并沿脸颊弯曲，更多浓密发束则与黑色背景相融。较清晰的眼睛直视前方，瞳孔有一处小反光；睫毛和虹膜比柔和的皮肤过渡更清晰。神情保持中性而直接。裁切范围不包括肩膀与衣物，画面完全聚焦于面部肌理和头发。面部仅略微转动，使鼻梁偏离中央，较远的脸颊落入更深色调。额头消失在一束头发下方，画面底边则紧贴嘴部之下裁切。如此紧凑的框取几乎不留背景空处，也让皮肤纹理成为画面重要部分。头发由大片黑色形体构成，边缘可见少量纤细发丝。浅亮光带从眉部沿鼻梁向下，并横过部分脸颊；嘴唇则被一条纤细暗线清楚分开。摄影式明暗过渡保留细小皮肤纹理和单根发丝。最亮色调集中于脸部中央，画面外缘则很快沉入黑色。正面柔光照亮露出的鼻梁、脸颊和眉部，被发束遮住的一侧则沉入深炭灰阴影。明暗范围从近白高光经过银灰中间调降至黑色，没有色彩强调。整体构图亲密而不对称：一只眼睛稳住右上方，被发束局部遮住的另一只眼牵引视线至左边缘，深色头发围合住肌理柔和的面孔，形成高反差画面。
style_prompt_en: The style uses monochrome tonal modelling, soft transitions, and visible fine-grain texture. Highlights move gradually into charcoal shadow, while edges alternate between crisp focal marks and blurred falloff. A narrow black-and-silver palette gives small bright areas strong weight. Surface grain remains present across midtones and adds a tactile quality without obscuring the forms. Directional light creates depth through gradual value changes rather than hard graphic shapes. The composition relies on close cropping, asymmetrical balance, and contrast between a pale field and dark framing masses.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格采用单色明暗塑造、柔和过渡和可见细颗粒纹理。高光逐渐沉入炭灰阴影，边缘则在清晰焦点与模糊虚化之间变化。黑银色窄色谱让小面积亮部也具有鲜明重量。中间调保留表面颗粒，增加触感，却不遮盖形体。方向性光线通过逐渐变化的明度建立纵深，而非依赖硬朗图形色块。构图依靠紧密裁切、不对称平衡，以及浅色区域与深色框景形体之间的反差。
theme_en: A tightly cropped monochrome face with dark hair and visible skin grain
theme_zh: 深发丝与肌理清晰的黑白面部特写
name: Niki Boon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
